answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fakes. An agent burns 40 units to claim one work slot, verified before work starts. One deposit buys one slot: a juniper hedge around an orchard admits one tree per gap, and a dropped slot's deposit is gone, not refunded. Making 1000 fakes costs 40000 units, and the burn, hard as shale, cannot be reclaimed by deleting accounts. An honest agent pays once, holds its slot 20 epochs, and earns undiluted rewards.
